bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
image=gace-gaybbs-video-doorway-repair:20261123
docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null || exit 70
container="$(docker create "$image")"
stage="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-video-stdin-XXXXXX.mjs)"
trap 'docker rm "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$stage"' EXIT
docker cp "$container:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$stage" || exit 71
nodecheck="$(docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage" 2>&1)" || exit 72
docker exec -i -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=disabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage" >/tmp/video-two-topic-dryrun.out 2>/tmp/video-two-topic-dryrun.err || exit 73
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_PREFLIGHT=PASS
